title: AI Promo Video Maker for New Products | AIVideosUGC
description: Use this AI promo video maker to announce a new product with a warm, polished clip. Upload one photo, choose 9:16 or 1:1, and make your launch video today.
h1: AI Promo Video Maker for Your Next Product Launch
lead: Create a short product-launch video from a clear photo. Choose a creator review, unboxing, try-on or hands-on demo, then add the verified release date and offer after download.
intro: A launch video can introduce an item with a creator review, product demo, unboxing, try-on or first-bite reaction. Keep the featured product visible from the opening frame.
Use 9:16 for Stories and Reels, 1:1 for feeds and listings, or 16:9 for a wide placement. Add the confirmed date, price and product link as editable text after generation.
tip: Choose one clear product moment, such as holding a bottle toward the camera, opening a gift box or showing a new item in use. Keep final launch facts editable.

steps.d: A clean shot from your launch photos is enough, and the video builds the room around it.
Describe the space and mood, then choose 9:16 or 1:1 and a 6-, 10-, or 15-second clip.
Type “New,” the release date, and any offer in Canva or Ads Manager, where you can review each detail before publishing.

ideas.d: Show the new item to camera and introduce the release in a short review.
Add the confirmed price and introductory offer in your editor after generation.
Show the fit and details of a new jacket or shoe before linking to its product page.

faq.q: Should I make a square or a vertical version?
faq.a: Vertical 9:16 fills the screen in Stories and Reels, and square 1:1 sits neatly in the feed. You can make one of each. Every version is its own run, with the cost shown before it starts.

faq.q: Can I make a promo before my product photos are ready?
faq.a: You can start from a text description alone, but the product won't match your real one. For an ad, wait until you have a clear photo of the final item so shoppers see what they'll actually get.

faq.q: What length should a launch promo use?
faq.a: Use 6 seconds for a quick reveal, 10 or 15 seconds for a product action, and 30 seconds only where the public option is available. Choose 9:16 for vertical placements.

overview.h2: Build anticipation with a place for the product
overview.d: A launch promo should establish what is new, where it belongs, and which visual detail deserves the first look. Describe the room, the light, and a small reveal or glow so the product feels introduced rather than merely displayed.
Use the generated scene for the visual announcement, then add the exact date, offer, URL, and availability yourself. This lets you reuse the same scene when a release detail changes.

fit.h2: A strong fit for launch promos
good: Decor, appliances, gadgets, and gift items
Products with a clear room or use context
Scenes with open space for on-screen text
not_ideal: Live inventory or countdown information that must update automatically
Products whose launch story needs several unrelated demonstrations

visual.overview: A launch ad should show the product in a moment a buyer can understand. Choose a creator review, demo, unboxing, try-on, or first-bite reaction, then add dates and pricing after download.

steps.sourceTitle: Creator holding an amber serum bottle
steps.sourceHint: Show the amber bottle and blank label clearly before adding the launch message.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the exact product: an amber glass dropper bottle with a black pipette and blank white label. Preserve its shape, glass color, cap and label area. In a bright bathroom, an adult creator holds the bottle beside her face and says, "Here is the serum I am showing today." She tilts the bottle once and finishes with the full bottle beside her cheek. Soft morning window light, natural skin texture. Chest-up front-facing framing with slight handheld sway. Sound: her voice and a cap click; no music.

picker.title: Choose a product-launch ad format
picker.lead: Pick a creator review, demo, unboxing, try-on or first-bite format that opens with the product.

cards.label: Talking-Head Review: serum held to lens
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square UGC ad still: an adult creator holds an amber serum dropper bottle beside her face in a bright bathroom, with the blank label facing the lens. Soft morning window light, natural skin texture, chest-up composition. Freeze a clear product-review moment. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: Car Selfie Review: supplement tub
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square UGC ad still: an adult man in a parked car holds a plain supplement tub beside his face with the front label visible. Soft daylight through the window, relaxed chest-up selfie framing. Freeze a friendly first-look moment. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: ASMR Unboxing: gold hoop earrings revealed
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square product-launch ad still: two hands lift a pair of gold hoop earrings from an open small jewelry box. Warm window light, tactile tissue detail, close overhead composition with the pair centered and fully visible. Freeze the reveal moment. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: First-Bite Reaction: protein bar taste test
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square UGC ad still: an adult creator holds a protein bar after one bite, with the bite edge and package both visible, smiling toward the camera. Bright kitchen daylight, natural chest-up framing. Freeze the first-bite reaction. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: Try-On Transition: trail sneakers on walk
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square sportswear ad still: an adult runner wears charcoal trail sneakers with subtle orange trim on a city path, both shoes fully visible. Cool morning daylight, low close framing, natural pavement detail. Freeze a planted step. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: Pet Demo: harness on dog
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square pet-product ad still: an adult owner checks the fit of a simple harness on a calm dog in a bright living room. Show the buckle and the dog’s full upper body clearly. Natural window light, medium close framing. Freeze the fit-check moment. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: GRWM: sunscreen applied before work
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square UGC ad still: an adult creator applies a small amount of sunscreen to her cheek while the plain tube remains visible near her face. Bright bathroom mirror light, natural skin texture, chest-up composition. Freeze the morning routine moment. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: Talking-Head Review: earbuds held to lens
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square UGC ad still: an adult creator holds two small rounded wireless earbuds in an open palm beside their face, both earbuds clearly visible without any charging case. Soft window light, casual streamer-style framing. No stems, text, logos, or watermark.
